avis.titre: Don't know yet what to say.  Have only used it for two weeks
avis.texte: Don't know what to say yet. Only used it for two weeks. No change yet in my eye appearance. Getting worried and disappointed. But I'm hopeful.
This is an amazing eye cream. Im 53 and it really helps with the wrinkles and puffiness, I will buy again!

avis.titre: I have nothing negative to say about this eye cream
avis.texte: I felt compelled to leave a review after seeing all the negative reviews. To each their own, but I really enjoy this eye cream. Its pricey, yes, but it works better than its cheaper counterparts. Its a very thick under eye cream which i love. Im 40 years old and always enjoyed a light under eye cream or a gel. That is until i tried Murad renewing eye cream. It goes on so creamy and feels wonderful. I have less visible wrinkles and an overall improvement of under eye appearance. When i use this cream, my under eye concealer is smooth and my makeup is always better.

Tried this out put a light layer on my under eyes, (so glad i didnt put it on my eye lids), and instantly felt weird, took it off and within 30 seconds to a minute my undeyes were burning and had red rashes. Should have tested or looked at reviews before trying, but like others, ive user other murad products and never had any issues so was assuming I would enjoy the product
Causes severe eye irritation and burning that did not subside for hours after first use.

I splurged and bought this eye cream. It felt good going on but within hours my eyes were stinging and watering and it was a miserable day. I have sensitive eyes, yet never had a problem with eye serums or creams.. I've never returned a beauty product and I'm grateful Ulta has a good return policy.

This is my second purchase of the eye cream. I have been using once a day for over 3 months. I do see improvement on the hydration and the appearance of very fine lines under my eyes. However, I do not see any improvement on dark circles whatsoever. I have not tried other products to compare; this was my first choice.

I've always really liked this eye cream, but it's gone up in price and the amount of product in the bottle is laughable…. Looks like about half the amount it used to be. In the past, I could easily stretch it out for at least a couple of months, now it seems to last about 4 weeks. Time to find something that's more economical as this is not worth it anymore.
I returned this after I realized I paid over $90 for it. Nothing is worth that price. And you still can't spell my name correctly - FYI.
Love this eye cream. So moisturizing! I've been using this for the last 15 years or so and feel it's the reason I don't have any crows feet at age 57.

This eye cream was refreshing and rejuvenating. It's a must in your skin care routine. It's size makes it easy to travel. So you can always take it on the go with you. If you are looking a great eye cream. This is it. Gifted by murad skincare. Must buy product

I received this product gifted by Murad Skincare for review. I love the instant results and have been using it daily under makeup and I love it! I always love Murad skincare products and it is one of my favorite skincare brands by far! If you want to invest in a great eye cream this is it!

From what I understand, you need to mix this with your moisturizer when you start to use at 2:1 or even 3:1. . And only every other day or two days in between to allow time for your skin to adapt to it. Then progress to using more the product after several weeks. I'm starting now and will report back. Yes, it is pricey. But I am willing to try anything at this point!

I've only been using this product for a few days but so far it seems to be helping with under eye puffiness. My complaint would be with the pump application. After every use, a drop dries up inside the nose of the pump, so the first bit that comes out is always a lump of cream which is hard to smooth over skin. Really disappointing for a product this pricey. I would not purchase again because of this malfunction.
Poorly designed. Cannot remove the top. Cannot see how much you've used.

avis.titre: Drying, nothing for puffiness or dark circles
avis.texte: For reference, I've used other eye creams and have never had any issues. This product was drying, not smooth under makeup, seemed to make the puffiness worse after a few hours, and did nothing for dark circles. It couldn't get it anywhere near my eye without me to tear up the rest of the day. There is a warning on the bottle about it coming into contact with eyes, but I thought that was unnecessary legalese. However, it really CAN'T come into contact with my eyes without some sort of reaction. So forget about putting it anywhere except about a 1/4 inch or further below your lash line or anywhere on your upper lid (because it seems to run down throughout the day). I kept wondering if it was just my imagination so I used half the bottle, hoping for a delayed effect. What's the point of this stuff?
I do not like the new design. There's no cap and you probably cannot remove the top to use up the last of this very expensive cream! Poorly designed!
This product is awful. I broke out in hives all over my face. Had the hives for 3 days now. Zero stars. Do not buy!!!!

avis.titre: I have used this product for years and it is phenomenal
avis.texte: I have used this product for years and my eye area is very smooth
This eye cream is perfect. It is light enough to wear under makeup, but does the trick. It's just right for hiding those little lines.
I am going on week 2 of this product and not real happy will be returning it to Ulta

I planned to give this eye cream a three star rating until I saw the price. There is nothing special about this cream. If I wanted to pay a heavy price for an eye cream, I'd spend the money on Shiseido Benefiance Wrinkle Smoothing Eye Cream. That cream makes a difference. This cream does not. It seems to moisturize a bit, but it's definitely not worth the high price tag.
Use this after using any of the Retinol Youth Renewal Creams on your eyes. Great moisturizer for your eyes & hastens the results of the creams aforementioned.
This works like a dream, even makes me feel awake. If you can afford it, I highly recommend it!

This is a nice product. Nothing really super special about it. It smells nice and is very silky. It feels great under my eyes, but I feel like I could get the same result from a more inexpensive product.

I've been using this religiously for some time now and while it has made my under eyes a bit smoother...fine lines are slightly less noticeable, I haven't noticed any changes dramatic enough to spend that much on the cream...especially when I didn't notice a change in brightness. Plus it's a little thick for the under eye but it does absorb well and great to apply makeup on top of. I just don't think i can justify the price....maybe i would get it again using rewards points.

avis.titre: I also got a rash from this):
avis.texte: I got a small sample of this and decided to try it. I read the Ulta reviews before using it and noticed people said they got a bad reaction from it, but I decided to use it. Well... I also have small tiny bumps under my eyes now too): I really like how the cream feels so I am sad it broke me out. If you think this could break you out, DO not use it.

I got a sample of this in a make up bag and was excited to try it. I've used murads moisturizer with spf and had a great experience so this was a treat, so I thought. I used it once, a light layer around my eyes on clean dry skin. The next day my eyes were itchy and irritated. Two days after I woke up with a red bumpy rash all around my eye area. It was so bad it lasted over a week. I still have red patches around my eyes two weeks later. If you are using this for the first time be sure to test it first on a small area not on the face.

I'm amazed at the difference this has made in such a short amount of time. I've been using every morning & night for about two weeks and my bags and wrinkles have already drastically reduced. I'll definitely continue to use as well as recommend to all of my friends & family!

avis.titre: Best eye cream I have ever used!
avis.texte: This is by far the best eye cream I have tried. It has noticeably brightened and plumped my under eyes. It's hydrating and goes on so smoothly.

I got a sample of this and was excited because I love a good eye cream. I'm 27 so I don't have too many aging concerns around my eyes yet, and I also don't really have much darkness or bags, but I do have some lines underneath and I definitely need moisture in that area. I've used it for the past several days and my eyes are now super dry, irritated, and burning. It didn't happen right away. At first, I kind of liked it. It isn't really moisturizing like I expected and wanted it to be, but the cream is pretty white and opaque so it has a bit of an instant brightening effect on my under eyes. However, after using it morning and night for the last few days, the skin around my eyes feels so raw. This morning was the first time I wore makeup on top of this eye cream and putting foundation on top of this cream made my under eyes disgustingly dry and scaly. It may work better for others or if it's used less frequently maybe, but it's just not moisturizing at all and makeup looks terrible on top of it so it doesn't work for me at all unfortunately.

I did not like this cream and it's weird because I have used Murad products before and has worked well for me. So, I decided to try this eye cream in particular and after using it for a couple of days it made one of my eyelids real dry and when I put it on sometimes I get this burning sensation. So a HUGE NO for me! I will continue using the other Murad products that I have used in the past. If works for you, that's great! Me personally, won't be using it again.

I was really excited to try this product because it was my first murad product. I've heard nothing but great things about the brand and when i saw the price tag i felt fancy using it but half way through the day of my first application my eyes started swelling up and over night they were even worst and the swelling and redness went all the way down my cheeks and my skin feels like it's burnt. Idk if I'm just allergic to something in the product but I've never had an allergic reaction and i use many different products and brands.

Love this eye cream! I used rewards dollars to get it so that helps me feel better about the cost, but it is by far the best eye cream I've used. It makes my eyes feel so supple and hydrated. My eye area is so much softer to the touch even than with other eye products! It just feels great. I also bought it when there was a big 36 item beauty bag included if you spent so much money so I'm not mad at the price or the decision to finally go all in on this item.

I had high hope for this product given the hefty price tag. I have also seen great reviews as well. I have dark circles under my eyes and I have been using this product for the past month religiously. I dab a small about onto my fingers and gently press it into my skin. I wait about 10 minutes for it to dry before applying a moisturizer. I have been doing this morning and night. I have not seen any changes whatsoever. I will not continue to use this product once the bottle is finished. Hopefully it works for others, but it hasn't done anything for me.
I have used this eye serum the past 5 years and love it! It actually minimizes eye wrinkles and is very gentle.

This is no doubt the best eye cream I've ever used. I use Murad products and really like them and this is no exception. When I ran out of my last bottle, I tried other brands hoping to save some money. But none of them worked like this. Some did absolutely nothing. So I finally gave in and bought this again. I know the pump container is what high end products usually come in but I HATE them! They are hard to travel with, when you get to the end of the container it's impossible to get all the product out. And at this price I hate to waste a molecule. PLEASE, manufacturers, put everything in a jar or a tube!! That way you can more easily put product into travel containers and use all the product you paid for.
I used to really love this brand but either my skin has changed or ingredients have changed. My skin stings when I apply this product and it is not gentle enough for my under eye area.
I have really bad dark circles and this made them go away instantly!!! Highly highly highly recommend! It's pricy but it's totally worth it.

avis.titre: I hope that I never have to give up this product.
avis.texte: Use am and pm. Single handedly reduced a small fold in my eye lid over my right eye. I have been using it for at lease 10-12 yrs. I'll never give it up

I have tried SOOOO many eye creams out in the market and this is by far the best one. It made my under eyes look and feel amazing. Youthful, rested and smooth. I recently switched to a new product and instantly regretted it.

I am an Aesthetican. So I know my skin care stuff. Im more of a budget buyer. But this is something you should spend your money on. Lasts forever Another good eye cream from Murad is the Vitamin C w/ Spf15 in it. Will buy over and over again.

So...the consistency of this is really nice. Its smooth and applies great, leaves eye area feeling 'moisturized' so i give it 3 stars. However, since using it, my genetic raccoon eyes have not brightened, theyve gotten darker. I will not continue use.

While the initial cost is tough to pay, the bottle lasted 6-7 months. I've used it almost regularly every day. I get dark circles under my eyes and puffiness. When I use it consistently, it really helped reduce and eliminate these problem spots. When I don't use it, they immediately start showing up. The initial expense is tough, but I look at the bottle as an $8-10 per month eye cream that works is so it's worth it.

avis.titre: Love this product!  Really works for under eye darkness!
avis.texte: I don't like spending tons of money on stuff I don't know if it will work. This stuff does. I've used it daily for at least 2 years and it has drastically minimized my genetic dark circles. Love this stuff! It's pricey but it works and 1 container lasts 6 months.

Ok ladies, when I tell you I have used many different eye creams I can honestly speak on this one as my holy grail!! I Love this wonderful find I have finally come across! I have crows feet but only when I smile big. This cream has softened the look of the crows feet and even diminished a few that I can tell. No other eye cream has worked liked this before. I see a couple of negative reviews so that tells me each under eye may react differently, Don't expect it totally rid the wrinkles but I have noticed a huge difference. I am 53 years old and I am very much into skin care. This one's a keeper!!

avis.titre: Started flaking on day one upon opening
avis.texte: Supposed to apply on eyelids and under eye area and it leaves white flakes on your skin every time you use

I got a sample and started using it about 2 weeks ago and I can definitely see a difference. I had really big bags under my eyes and was starting to develop crows feet. After 2 weeks of usage, my eyes are less puffy, they are noticeably lighter underneath, and my crows feet are gone. Would highly recommend for others.

I got a sample and waivered on spending the money on this eyecream. I've tried others but I break out w white heads or skin gets dry. Murad works great w my sensitive skin. Does make my eye area look brighter and less tired but wishedit helped more w dark circles.

Love this eye cream! Has long term benefits in that it has retinal and other beneficial ingredients to help lessen the look of aging. Has immediate benefits in that it moisturizes yet absorbs quickly and it seems to help smooth out or "fill in" fine lines a little.

I like the texture of this. I got it in a little tiny sample tube, but you really don't need very much at all. It's a little heavy, though, kinda thick and greasy, and it actually gave me hives. That's attractive.

I got a free sample of this a while ago and I loved it but I held off on buying the full-size product because of the price. I was looking for a really good eye cream to help with my under eye area - I have a lot of crepey, loose skin and under eye wrinkles. I tried a lot of other brands and nothing compared. I even tried some other higher end products that had good reviews and I ended up taking the last one back because it burned my skin and made my eyes water constantly. I decided it was time I took the plunge and bought the full-size bottle. I'm so happy with it. This product is definitely worth the price and the results are amazing. I love it!
I apply this product in the morning before my makeup and at night
This product helped my dark circles and puffiness after only 2 days use.

I got a sample of this and put it under my eyes and in just a few minutes the results were amazing! I could Not believe what I was seeing. The undereye wrinkles were 95? gone. Since turning 40 I have developed undereye wrinkles pretty bad. And then I got this. I had to buy some. Thank you Murad.

I got a sample of this, and it has done a 180 on my eye lids! My lids are always dry, peeling, and lately they've been very bumpy with a lot of texture. I noticed a difference after the first use, and after finding out how pricey it is, I've been using it every other day - and my lids are still smooth and flake free! Will definitely purchase the full size, this is the ONLY thing that has helped me!

avis.titre: Yes I would buy this product again
avis.texte: I use this product around my eyes. This product works better than most products that I used.

avis.auteur: Always looking for a good product!
avis.texte: So far, I have been impressed with the product. I am only a week into trying it, but really love how light weight it is. It is not irritating to my eyes, but yet, seems to be effective.
It's expensive but it does work to make skin my hydrated and not so wrinkled
A little goes a long time no way. I am 69 years old & have always tried to take care of my skin & this is the best eye product I've ever used!
Have not seen noticeable improvements, but it does smooth the eye area and hydrates.
Using every day for a couple weeks and no results, product is a little sticky

This product is really expensive for the tiny bottle. Because it's like liquid gold for the fine lines around your eyes!! I haven't notice a difference in the under eye puffiness but it turned back time like 10 yrs!!! Try and get it when they are having a sale....you only need a little so it lasts a long time! Can't go without it now...
This product is a miracle worker on dark circles... it is pricey but I can't go without it.

Purchased with a coupon since the price is outrageous! This eyecream wasn't awful, there are just way more cost-friendly options. I noticed less puffiness after using, but that is about it. It also smells like bleu cheese, which I'm not a fan of.

Iam 41 and good skin, however am experiencing under eye darkness and puffiness. I've used this cream everyday, usually twice a day for over a month with no results. Wouldn't be so disappointed if not for the high price.
I'm a HUGE Murad fan, however, this really irritated my eyes. The consistency is good & it absorbed into my skin nicely. if you have sensitive eyes though, this might not be for you.
Within a couple weeks of using this product, the dark circles under my eyes were fading. I have been using this product for over 6 months and love it.
This eye cream is the best I've used so far to reduce puffiness and my wrinkles are less noticeable.
The results are the same at a much higher cost when compared to less costly alternatives.

It seems to be a thick eye cream. It's hard to tell if it lightens the eye flesh since I apply and remove makeup daily. I can be sensitive but do not notice any problems with this product. There is no sloughing or residue with this product.

I noticed results immediately! If I miss two days in a row I go running back to this. I love that I can use it on my upper and lower eye areas. It is worth every penny. The best part: No stinging No burning No itching No red Eyes I always quit using an eye product if it irritates my eyes. That is why I am in love with it! I am trying to look better not irritate my eyes. This product could probably be rubbed on your eyeball without noticing. Not that I would recommend that...

I'm 27 this year and started using anti wrinkle cream at 25. Although no cream will ever diminish all wrinkles (especially if guide a smoker/drinker etc) I believe that wrinkle cream at least makes a difference. Next to philosophy., this is the best eye cream on the market. I fully support all Murad products because they work. I applaud this product and its worth every hard earned penny. I work in customer service, so obviously this isn't easy money to spend. But truthfully, nothing else can compare. It's worth it!

I received a small sample of this eye cream at Christmas. I'm 43 and have deep wrinkles under my eyes due to eczema breakouts I suffer from. Just using half of this tiny little sample I've seen a HUGE difference!! My husband even notice and he doesn't notice things like that! Might splurge in it if I keep seeing results from this sample.
I really like the container that this eye serum is in. You can get just the amount you want.

First ten days i had a good deal of eye irritation which eventually stopped. Especially in the morning, red, swollen eyelids i stopped using it and the reaction stopped...resumed three days later and the problem resumed as well so i know it wasn't something else.. Its a good, rich moisturizer that plumped up the tissue under my eyes which made my wrinkles look somewhat better and filled in the crepiness....but truthfully....it does nothing long term. I am a former sun worshiper...at 45 i am showing my age but not too badly. Its a decent product but I expected wayyyyy more from a product that costs $80 for half an ounce. Disappointing from Murad.
The one thing that is not perfect, is that it always has just a little slightly dried product dispensed w/ each application.

Lets start by saying the product is pricey, second I did not notice any improvement and it did irritate my eyes. I will apply before bed and I am very careful with the application, but the product will always seem to irritate my eyes and make me teary. I will not recommend this product, pricey and you would not see any difference in your eyes!

avis.titre: Love the product HATE the packaging
avis.texte: I got a tiny version of this in a Murad combo pack, and I absolutely loved the eye cream. I used it daily and saw improvement in the fine lines under my eyes, which is important during the winter. I splurged and bought the full sized version. Unfortunately, the pump that this comes in is terrible. Enough of the product is held in the pump that by the next night when I use it, it's dried out and gritty. I do NOT want to put that gritty product on my eyes, but it means that 50% of the product is wasted every time I use it. Even though I love the product, I won't repurchase in this packaging.
I dab a small amount under my eyes, just below the brows and on the sides. It helps to eliminate puffiness and moisturize the skin around my eyes.

Have used this great product for years & love it. However,the container does not dispense the last 15 to 20% of the product. I have to take it apart with tiny pliers & tweezers & scrape the balance of the product into another container. This is a tedious process but the product is too expensive to trash so much of it.
it has the perfect complexion - not too greasy, just the perfect moisture balance for the periorbital area

avis.titre: Did research, read reviews; didn't work.
avis.texte: May not be the best choice for someone who has extremely sensitive skin. I still have a 1/3 of the product left and all I can do is shake my head at the money I wasted. Lost the receipt, lesson learned!

Think the Review Headline says it all.... Luv Murad. I've used Murad for several years and recently decided to tray another brand that was advertised with alot of hype. After 3 weeks with the "new" product(s) i realized just how bad, old & wrinkled I was looking so I switched back! After a few days I noticed an improvement and withing a week I looked much better, less wrinkled and felt better about my sppearance.
Very easy to use...a little goes a long way. Absorbs quickly and does not irritate your eyes.
I've tried them all and this is the best stuff for eyes. I can see an immediate improvement. I am hooked on this entire Murad line.

avis.titre: Great and effective line of products
avis.texte: I purchased the entire line of products a little over a week ago and I am seeing great results. My skin feels dewey and refreshed. I saw and felt results after one day of using this line. Will buy again.
Feels lovely, smells great, after using for a week I notice fine lines have diminished and dark circles have lightened. Love it!
This is a great product and I have used it for years. It is pricey, but I would not change brands for a cheaper nock off.

I purchased product for the first time based on reviews. I could tell I liked it better than the Exuviance eye cream that I have been using for a couple of years, after one application. After using it less than one week I no longer needed under-eye concealer. I swear to you I am not exaggerating. Also the very fine lines under my eyes and at the corners nearly disappear. At 56 years old I am completely shocked at the results I am getting from Murad. I Never write reviews but I just had to write this because this product gave me such unbelievably great results.

avis.titre: Best I've found for the price
avis.texte: i'm on my second bottle of this and really like it a lot. very effective.
I have used this product for 3 years with wonderful results. I am in my 50's and am usually mistaken for being 10 to 15 years younger. Love this product! Drinking lots of water helps too.

I have recently become super sensitive to some skincare products. I have had rosacea for many years without sensitivity to any facial products. But, over the last 3-4 months, my skin has reacted negatively to several gentle skincare products. Unfortunately, this Murad eye cream is one of those products. My eye area became red, itchy and more dry than before after only a couple of days usage. I had to return this product. I am a budget shopper but I'm willing to pay a premium price for a product that works for me. Sadly, this one did not.
I used as directed and have noticed a nice glow and softness to my fine lines
I was about to give up. [...] This cream is pricey, but a little goes a long way. I saw a difference immediately and more changes, the longer I used it. Good stuff.

avis.titre: Finally an eye cream that works
avis.texte: I've spent years and a lot of money looking for the perfect eye cream. One that actually works and wouldn't irritate my eyes. Murad Renewing Eye Cream was created for menopausal and peri-menopausal skin, which is perfect for me. I received a sample with an online Murad order and fell in love instantly. Then I found it just down the street at my local Ulta Store. Yippeeee! Only downside is that it is expensive. Fortunately just a small amount makes a big difference. Just hoping it will last a long while.
Love this product! Other eye creams have irritated my skin, but not this one. Helps soften wrinkles quickly & tightens skin a bit.

I was surprised with how well this tightened the skin around my eyes. It reduces the depth of the lines and crepiness of the skin texture. It absorbs quickly so I can easily layer my primer and concealer over it. It really smoothes out the eye area. I like the fact that it makes me look 10 years younger. Great stuff.
good product, I've been using the murad products for 6 months - each regular size product last about 3 months

Excellent product that produces noticeable positive results for the skin around my eyes. This firms the skin, help fine lines fade, soothes dryness and tightness, and helps skin look bright and healthy. One container lasts 2.5-4 months, depending upon whether I use it only at night, or night and day. Most eye products last me a month, so the high cost of Murad isn't unreasonable for the high concentration and effectiveness of this cream. It's my very favorite eye treatment, and I'm happy to repurchase this great product.

Recently at my salon they offered this product so I gave just the eye cream a try. Wow... it works. Those laugh lines around the eyes what a difference. My lines went 1-1/2" below my eyes and now they are even with my eyeline. The product works. Due to concentration, this size lasted me 2 1/2 months. I wish your coupons worked with this product.
